Katie — thanks for the heads up and the doc. Sorry to hear about the freeze; we anticipated procurement windows could be tight.

Short answers: yes, there are practical options. A quick proposal below:

1) Short-term pilot continuity: switch the pilot to Hosted API (no procurement required) for the evaluation period. We can set token caps and IP allowlists to mirror production controls.
2) Dedicated purchase rebaseline: move the dedicated capacity order to a June 20 purchase date (post-freeze) and update MAP milestones accordingly.
3) Contingency credit: offer a one-time trial credit to offset incremental hosted usage for the period (we'll confirm amount after ops feedback).

I've looped Marissa (sales lead) and Neha (procurement liaison) to confirm operational feasibility and to draft the MAP amendment. If that sounds okay, I propose a short call tomorrow to agree owners and sign-off cadence.

Next steps:
- Ops to verify Hosted throughput and isolation constraints (Neha)
- Redline MAP amendment and send for signature (Marissa -> doc)
- Confirm updated acceptance & go-live dates with procurement (Katie/Josh)

Will follow up with a proposed one-page amendment this week.

Best,
Ben

Ben/Neha — appreciate the quick pivot. I ran this by Ops and Product:

Operational notes (from Ops):
- Hosted API can sustain the pilot traffic for up to 25 concurrent requests/sec under current token quotas; we recommend a soft cap of 100k tokens/day to control cost.
- KV cache semantics differ slightly from the Dedicated runtime; some latency variance is expected during peak runs.
- We can script a seamless migration path (prefix-preserve, KV export) when Dedicated is provisioned.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Data governance — procurement requires VPC/pinned capacity for certain PH data domains.
  Mitigation: Restrict hosted traffic to de-identified test sets and escrow logs for audit; include a short data handling appendix in the amendment.
- Risk: Budget delta for Hosted usage.
  Mitigation: Provide a $12k hosted credit toward evaluation over the freeze window; will need CS approval.

I've attached an ops impact snapshot and a draft amendment skeleton (proposed_map_amendment_v1.docx). If Ben can finalize the owner list and acceptance dates, I'll push the amendment to DocuSign and loop Legal for a quick review.

Marissa
